title: Frontiers: Asymmetric Effects of Recreational Cannabis Legalization
authors: Pengyuan Wang; Guiyang Xiong; Jian Yang
near_miss_reason: Staggered state recreational-cannabis legalization (7 treated, disguised states; adoption weeks clustered near weeks 57-63, 72-84 and 142-171 of 173, consistent with AK/DC Feb 2015, OR Jul 2015 and CA/MA/NV/ME Nov 2016-Jan 2017; 10 never-treated states) with state and week FE on weighted state-week-device-gender-age cells. Every column violates a rule: Model (1) adds additive device, gender and youth FE (nonredundant additive FE, 5b 'age FE'), Model (2) also interacts treat_post with youth. Data are a disguised 1,000-row subsample.
eligible_reason: Design is staggered but no column satisfies every rule (additive demographic/device FE in Model (1); youth x treatment interaction in Model (2)). Even if Model (1) were admitted, the package ships only a disguised, demeaned 1,000-row subsample per substance with disguised state IDs, so eligible = false either way.
design_notes: sample_code.R estimates Models (1) and (2) of Section 2.3 for cannabis search and for alcohol and tobacco search, click-through and revenue per impression (7 outcome-substance pairs x 2 models = 14 columns). Unit of observation: state x week x device (desktop/tablet/mobile) x gender x youth cell, weighted (weight_search/click/revenue); no clustering in the code (default lm SE). Treatment treat_post = 1 for legalizing states after legalization. Unit = state, time = week (1-173).
data_files_note: readme.pdf: 'The proprietary data used in this paper is under non-disclosure agreement (NDA)... we provide a disguised random subsample of the dataset'; outcomes demeaned and state identifiers disguised 'as required by the data provider'. Each file has 1,000 rows (full panel ~17 states x 173 weeks x 12 cells).
data_provenance_note: Disguised (demeaned outcomes, masked state IDs) 1,000-row random subsample; not in data/synthetic_packages.txt, lead may want to add it.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally and the OpenAlex abstract is empty; design read from readme.pdf and sample_code.R, adoption timing checked in the subsample (python3 -I pandas). Table numbers and published coefficients not confirmed. Judgment call for the lead: additive device/gender/youth dummies treated as nonredundant additive FE (protocol 5b 'age FE'), not as controls, so near_miss_5c_controls_only = false; the data rule excludes the paper regardless.
